item.title: #SSAWmagazine AW6In the great encyclopaedia of rock, her story s...
item.description: #SSAWmagazine AW6In the great encyclopaedia of rock, her story sounds like a distorted fairy tale: a young, flame-haired Canadian bass player, plucked out of obscurity to join Hole, the band fronted by Courtney Love, only weeks after the death of both her husband, Kurt Cobain, and Kristen Pfaff, the previous musician to have held the job. Melissa Auf der Maur stepped into a storm, which she weathered for five years, before leaving and spending a year as the bassist in Smashing Pumpkins. 5 years after one of the most intense creative eras in music, the Montreal-born artist returns with both a memoir and a photo book revealing her own viewpoint, exponentially expanded by an incredible body of work. As her memoir Even the Good Girls Will Cry reveals, she captured every single moment of her journey using the Nikon camera she carried with her at all times. While the text tells of her emotional journey, the monograph My ’9s Rock Photographs displays the vast archive of images collected over the last analogue decade in human existence. From her home in New York State, Auf der Maur looks back at an era and an archive which took almost a quarter century to process.-Melissa Auf der Maur in conversation with Nathalie FraserPhotography @jjennawestraaStyling @roxanedansetHair and make-up @christinecherbonnier @thewallgroupProduction @sashita_bonitaPhotography Assistant @kathydisco-Melissa wears @maisonvalentino by @alessandro_michele

item.title: CITY OF ANGELSghosts, the red lady, cameos and beautiful contrad...
item.description: CITY OF ANGELSghosts, the red lady, cameos and beautiful contradictions.LACMA: Celebrating My ’9s Rock Photographs in a sprawling Brutalist empire of art, hosted my conversation with fellow Celtic warrior goddess Shirley Manson. After crashing the museum’s ticketing site by selling out so quickly to passionate Angelenos, our one-hour conversation barely scratched the surface of the epic themes we explored: Analog Humans, Women of All Times, Gen X, Photography, and our band’s places in the glory and mess of it all…I want more. I want to go deeper with her, in honor of our collective memory, to infuse some light into this wild, unknown future being built around us (and the atrocious human behavior we are currently witnessing across the globe)…NPLANNED CAMEO by NMBER 1 Warrior Goddess Courtney Love (that’s right, I call you that, and you can kiss and tease my witchy Stevie Nicks ass my friend ha ha!) - on behalf of the global world, we apologize for how you were treated and we are all in agreement that “we all owe you and you are so beloved and so respected by anyone who fucking matters!”AmenXLos Angeles! You came out for us! Eternally grateful that, my wild, defining, coming into womanhood, chapter in your lights and hills, still connects me so deeply to you all.Thank you for coming out, supporting and WAITING IN THAT BOOK SIGNING LINE?!!Patience is a virtue. It has paid off for me ten folds, three decades later, thanks for waiting with me.xMxP.S. The Sunset Tower ghosts travelled through me during that visit, whispered notions of “pulse of desire is connected to the pain of death” do what you will, put that in your pipe and smoke it for those of you who listen to the voices on the other side ….!!!!Dream dress by @samanthapleet + @francescadimattioGlitter cinch by @electricfeathersofficialIsis pendant by Egypt via @nadiasomersetPro-photos by Kristin Burns @kristinburnsstudio

item.title: Thursday, Nov. 5: Melissa Auf der Maur, bassist for Hole and the...
item.description: Thursday, Nov. 5: Melissa Auf der Maur, bassist for Hole and the Smashing Pumpkins, joins Michael Lindsay-Hogg to discuss the inside history of rock 'n roll!Before entering the music scene, Auf der Maur studied photography in Montreal. The craft followed her into her career as a touring musician. She caught some of the rawest, most intimate moments of the 9s alternative rock scene on camera: bandmates sleeping on buses, lounging in pools, dancing in crowds. In 6, these photos went up at the Art Gallery of Ontario, and into her book, My 9s Rock Photographs.Melissa will sign the photo-book and her personal memoir, Even the Good Girls Will Cry, at our event next Thursday. Check our link to learn more!

item.title: Rock is not dead !Née à Montréal, Melissa Auf der Maur a étu...
item.description: Rock is not dead !Née à Montréal, Melissa Auf der Maur a étudié la photographie à l’niversité Concordia avant de devenir bassiste des groupes de rock alternatif Hole, dans les années 9, puis des Smashing Pumpkins. Sur les routes, elle continuait de prendre des photos, et demandait une pellicule 35 mm à chaque salle de concert dans sa fiche technique. Cette démarche a donné naissance à une archive de plus de 1 images documentant la vie sur scène et loin de la foule. Son autobiographie, Even The Good Girls Will Cry, a été publiée au printemps 6 par Da Capo et Grand Central Publishing.La Gaîté accueille une discussion avec Sophie Hackett & Melissa Auf der Maur pour revenir sur son expérience au cœur de la scène rock alternative des années 199, les souvenirs qui ont marqué son parcours et les histoires derrière ses photographies. Sam. 14.11 à 15h Audito Billetterie en ligne
